## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, affected modules, and related issue.

## Validation

List exact configure/build/test commands, platform/toolchain, configuration, and
results. For graphics changes, include backend/device/driver and actual runtime
evidence. Identify environments or tests you could not run.

## Compatibility and review

- [ ] Changes are focused; generated files and unrelated formatting are excluded.
- [ ] Applicable regression tests and dependent consumers were checked.
- [ ] Public API, serialized data, dependencies, and documentation impacts are described.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details use the private reporting process.

Describe remaining risks or migration requirements where applicable.
